svg.aria-label: 02. Sulehri. My own project. An AI tutor that lives next to your mouse on the Mac. Hold two keys and ask out loud: it explains in simple words, by voice, while it points, underlines and draws on your actual screen. Role: Designer and developer. Built: Mac app, live drawing on the screen, voice in and out, lesson board. Stack: Swift, AppKit, Speech, WebKit, Claude, Kokoro voice.
